drivingQuestion: Does a betrothed-then-divorced na'ara who is raped receive the fine, and to whom?

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נַעֲרָה שֶׁנִּתְאָרְסָה וְנִתְגָּרְשָׁה — רַבִּי יוֹסֵי הַגְּלִילִי אוֹמֵר: אֵין לָהּ קְנָס. רַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹמֵר: יֵשׁ לָהּ קְנָס, וּקְנָסָהּ לְעַצְמָהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a young woman who was betrothed and divorced,» and then raped, «Rabbi Yosei HaGelili says: She does not» receive payment of a «fine» for her rape. «Rabbi Akiva says: She» receives payment of a «fine» for her rape «and her fine» is paid «to herself,» not her father, as since she was betrothed and divorced she is no longer subject to her father’s authority.

moves.summary: no fine for a betrothed-and-divorced na'ara
moves.about: whether a na'ara who was betrothed and divorced and then raped receives the fine, and to whom it is paid

moves.summary: she receives a fine, and it is hers
